title: user.merged
description: A guest account was folded into an existing one on sign-in (stapel-auth 0.30.0): from_user_id ceased to exist and its rows belong to into_user_id. Consumed here as the opposite instruction to user.deleted — stapel-cdn re-points uploaded_by on Image, Video, File and Audio instead of erasing anything, folding a guest object whose bytes the survivor already holds into the survivor's row (owner-scoped dedup means one blob may carry two rows). Idempotent: a redelivery finds nothing left under the guest.
